children.value: > Fact From Story Ruby Franke pleaded guilty to child abuse charges and will go to prison for trying to convince her two youngest children they were evil, possessed and needed to be punished to repent.
> > Fact From Story Each charge carries a sentence of one to 15 years in prison.

> > Fact From Story Under Utah law, second-degree aggravated child abuse can be charged if that person knowingly or intentionally inflicts serious physical injury to a child or causes or permits another to inflict serious physical injury to their child.

> > > Fact From Story Franke admits that she tortured her son from May 22 through Aug. 30 by forcing him into hours of physical tasks, summer work outdoors without adequate water and “repeated and serious sunburns” that blistered. | Fact From Story
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Torturing a child and causing them serious physical harm is considered child abuse. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge People who plead guilty to crimes are typically sentenced for those crimes.
> Commonsense Knowledge Child abuse is illegal.
